intent: Count how many of the 6 specified product variants have available_today_quantity >= 4 at the Vienna Praterstern store today.

params.p2_family: Loctite Threadlocker EA 3UJ-5ML Adhesive and Glue
params.p4_family: Hammerite Quick Dry HAM 22B-SYZ Metal and Concrete Paint
params.p5_family: Uvex Bionic x-fit Y59-F8N Work Jacket
params.p6_family: Knipex Professional KP 2H0-CV1 Pliers and Wrenches

success_criteria: Each of the 6 product specs resolves to exactly one product_sku via brand + product_family_name + its distinguishing variant properties.
Count = number of those SKUs whose store_inventory.available_today_quantity >= 4 at the Vienna Praterstern store.
refs cite only the record_path of products that ARE available (>=4); excluded/unavailable products are not referenced.

args.stdin: SELECT store_id, record_path, store_name, city FROM stores WHERE city='Vienna' AND store_name LIKE '%Praterstern%';

SELECT pf.product_family_name, pv.product_sku, p.property_key, p.property_value_text, p.property_value_number FROM product_families pf JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.product_family_id=pf.product_family_id JOIN product_variant_properties p ON p.product_sku=pv.product_sku WHERE pf.product_family_name IN ('Hager Workshop HAG 1RH-81U Extension Cable','Loctite Threadlocker EA 3UJ-5ML Adhesive and Glue','Ajax Concentrate Fresh 252-QRO Cleaning Liquid','Hammerite Quick Dry HAM 22B-SYZ Metal and Concrete Paint','Uvex Bionic x-fit Y59-F8N Work Jacket','Knipex Professional KP 2H0-CV1 Pliers and Wrenches') ORDER BY pf.product_family_name, pv.product_sku, p.property_key;

WITH s AS (SELECT store_id FROM stores WHERE city='Vienna' AND store_name LIKE '%Praterstern%'), t AS ( SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id=pv.product_family_id WHERE pv.brand='Hager' AND pf.product_family_name='Hager Workshop HAG 1RH-81U Extension Cable' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='color_family' AND p.property_value_text='Gray') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key IN('length_m','length','cable_length_m') AND (p.property_value_number=2 OR p.property_value_text IN('2 m','2'))) UNION ALL SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id=pv.product_family_id WHERE pv.brand='Loctite' AND pf.product_family_name='Loctite Threadlocker EA 3UJ-5ML Adhesive and Glue' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='adhesive_type' AND p.property_value_text='threadlocker') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='color_family' AND p.property_value_text='Brown') UNION ALL SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id=pv.product_family_id WHERE pv.brand='Ajax' AND pf.product_family_name='Ajax Concentrate Fresh 252-QRO Cleaning Liquid' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='cleaner_type' AND p.property_value_text='glass cleaner') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key IN('volume_ml','volume') AND (p.property_value_number=750 OR p.property_value_text IN('750 ml','750'))) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='surface' AND p.property_value_text='glass') UNION ALL SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id=pv.product_family_id WHERE pv.brand='Hammerite' AND pf.product_family_name='Hammerite Quick Dry HAM 22B-SYZ Metal and Concrete Paint' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='product_type' AND p.property_value_text='concrete sealer') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='color_family' AND p.property_value_text='Blue') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='finish' AND p.property_value_text='satin') UNION ALL SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id=pv.product_family_id WHERE pv.brand='Uvex' AND pf.product_family_name='Uvex Bionic x-fit Y59-F8N Work Jacket' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='color_family' AND p.property_value_text='Gray') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='size' AND p.property_value_text='L') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='fit' AND p.property_value_text='slim') UNION ALL SELECT pv.product_sku, pv.record_path FROM product_variants pv JOIN product_families pf ON pf.product_family_id=pv.product_family_id WHERE pv.brand='Knipex' AND pf.product_family_name='Knipex Professional KP 2H0-CV1 Pliers and Wrenches' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key='tool_type' AND p.property_value_text='socket wrench') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM product_variant_properties p WHERE p.product_sku=pv.product_sku AND p.property_key IN('length_mm','length') AND (p.property_value_number=125 OR p.property_value_text IN('125 mm','125'))) ) SELECT t.product_sku, t.record_path, si.available_today_quantity FROM t JOIN store_inventory si ON si.product_sku=t.product_sku JOIN s ON s.store_id=si.store_id WHERE si.available_today_quantity >= 4;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When answering availability questions - answer should reference products that are available, but should not reference unavailable products. Same with stores.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
Note that inventory lives only in SQL projections
